# Migration and Continuity Constraints

## Business Continuity

- Case handling must remain available during working hours.
- Operations considers an interruption longer than two hours unacceptable.
- The Monday reporting pack must continue throughout transition.
- Existing saved searches and common keyboard actions require explicit review
  before removal.

## Data

- Eight years of case history must remain searchable.
- Attachments associated with retained cases must remain accessible.
- Duplicate people, inconsistent categories, and missing attachment metadata
  require a treatment decision.
- The authoritative source for several reference values is unknown.

## Transition

- Migration approach, sequencing, reconciliation, and rollback conditions are
  not approved.
- Parallel operation may reduce cutover risk but could create duplicate case
  updates.
- User preparation is required, but no training or adoption plan exists.
- The team has not decided whether historical data will be transformed or
  presented in a read-only archive.
